fact: UNICEF's terms of reference say the Ministry of Education and Training began upgrading its EMIS in August 2019 by testing the OpenEMIS Core toolkit, that the system remained paper-based, highly centralised and of limited capability to track data by individual learner or teacher at school, that the Ministry remains the owner of the data, and that a costed OpenEMIS implementation plan for 2023-2028 was to be written.
title: International Consultant to support strengthening of the Education Management Information System (EMIS), Maseru, Lesotho
